en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  narrates  that  the  Holy  Prophet (s.a.w.s.)  said,  “Shaban  is  my  month  and  Ramadan  is  the month of Allah. It is spring for the poor. The Almighty Allah has  made  Eid-ul-Azha  so  that  poor  get  to  eat  meat  and hence you should perform Qurbani and offer meat to them.”
